title: Newton's 3rd Law
plot_overview: An investigation into a double murder in 1999 draws unexpected people into a search for justice. As they pursue the case, intrigue and secrets complicate their efforts, bringing together characters who might not otherwise be involved in the investigation.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like murder investigations, stories about unexpected people joining forces, and mysteries shaped by intrigue; Not for you if you prefer light, low-stakes plots.
review_summary: Pros: intriguing mystery; search for justice; unexpected characters | Cons: limited details; secrets may complicate things
